**Choose Sentry.** I'm working from memory and didn't check live pricing, so confirm the numbers below before you commit.

| | **Sentry** | **Rollbar** | **Bugsnag** (SmartBear) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Best at** | Web and backend errors, plus tracing, session replay and profiling in one product | Fast setup, strong error grouping, deploy tracking | Mobile apps, stability scores, release health |
| **SDK coverage** | Broadest, with first-class support for most languages and frameworks | Good, narrower | Good, with its best SDKs on mobile (iOS, Android, React Native, Unity) |
| **Beyond errors** | Performance tracing, replay, profiling, cron and uptime monitoring | Mostly errors, with some telemetry | Errors, plus stability and release monitoring |
| **Pricing model** | Per plan and event volume, with unlimited seats on paid tiers (Team is about $26/mo to start) | Per event volume, with unlimited seats (paid plans start around $14/mo) | Per event volume and seats, usually the priciest of the three at team scale |
| **Self-hosting** | Yes (source-available) | No | No |
| **Ecosystem** | Largest community, many integrations, and the most documentation | Solid integrations | Solid integrations, with a SmartBear suite tie-in |

**Why Sentry for a 10-person team**
- **One tool:** a team this size usually doesn't want separate products for errors, performance and replay. Sentry covers all three.
- **Seat cost:** unlimited users on paid plans means you pay for event volume, not for headcount as you grow.
- **Unproven needs:** the free tier and cheap Team plan let you try it, and self-hosting is available if data residency ever matters.
- **Community:** most integrations and answers online are for Sentry.

**When to pick something else**
- **Bugsnag:** if you're mostly a mobile team and care about crash-free-session metrics and release stability gating.
- **Rollbar:** if you only want a simple, cheap error tracker with good grouping and deploy correlation, and you don't need tracing or replay.

**Caveats**
- Sentry's event-based billing can surprise you during an error spike. Set spike protection and sampling rates from day one.
- The right choice depends on your stack. If you tell me your languages, whether you ship mobile apps, and your expected event volume, I can sharpen this. I can also look up current pricing if you want.
